arguments.message: When you downgrade, nothing is deleted. Any features or data that belong to the higher‑tier plan become hidden, but the underlying data stays in your workspace and will reappear if you upgrade again. The only exception is data that exceeds the lower tier’s retention window – over time, records older than that window will age out just as they would on a workspace that started on that tier.
